purpose: Teach: 亀裂/覚せい/熱烈/サリン/加速度/臨界/培養/入管

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織内に亀裂が生じている兆候を警察、察知されてますね
lines.en: The organization is showing signs of fracture, and I believe police have detected this.
lines.style: Measured, intellectually careful. Soft attack on the opening. Slight pause before the observation, as if thinking through the implications. Steady, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、覚せい剤事案を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: The police department is implementing strict crackdowns on stimulant-related cases.
lines.style: Official, measured, direct. Even tone throughout. No emotion—just statement of fact and protocol. Precise articulation, professional distance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、熱烈なファンによる迷惑行為を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: There's been concerning fan behavior in this case, and I understand the police are monitoring the situation closely.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly troubled. Gentle but clear articulation. The concern is real but controlled. Pause before 'monitoring'—choosing words with care.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、過去のサリン事件の教訓を引き継ぎます
lines.en: The police are drawing on lessons learned from past incidents like Sarin to inform our approach.
lines.style: Respectful, weighted. Slower pace on the reference to history. Not heavy-handed, but this carries gravity. Deliberate, composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、加速度的に増えている事案を警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: Cases like this are accelerating, and the police are maintaining close surveillance.
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. Measured delivery but a thread of urgency. Not alarming—factual but aware. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、危険物の臨界量を厳重に管理します
lines.en: Critical materials are being managed with the highest security protocols.
lines.style: Firm, assured, official. Clear enunciation on 'critical' and 'highest.' No room for misunderstanding. Professional confidence without coldness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不正培養菌の流通を警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: The circulation of illegally cultured biological materials is under active investigation.
lines.style: Serious, deliberate. Slightly slower pace. Each word carries weight. Clinical but not detached—this is serious business. Steady through to the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、入管との連携を強化しております
lines.en: We're strengthening coordination with immigration authorities on this.
lines.style: Direct, slightly warmer than previous lines. Collaborative tone—'we're'—shows unity of purpose. Still professional but with a hint of connection.
